name: Read a share's balance and status
description: Reads the balance and status of one of a member's shares, identified by its share-code suffix (S0001, S0070, MMKT, CERT, or a numbered variant such as MMKT-4).

inputParams.name: shareCode
inputParams.description: Share suffix identifying which share to read, e.g. S0001, S0070, MMKT, CERT, MMKT-4.

outputs.name: shareId
outputs.description: Extract the Share ID for the row matching memberId-shareCode

outputs.name: balance
outputs.description: Extract the Balance for the row matching memberId-shareCode

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Extract the Status for the row matching memberId-shareCode

steps.description: Navigate directly to member record page for member ${memberId}
Extract the Share ID for the row matching memberId-shareCode

locator.reason: exact match on td cell text avoids ambiguity with row accessible name
positional fallback: third row (header + S0001 + S0070), first column is Share ID

steps.description: Extract the Balance for the row matching memberId-shareCode

locator.reason: Balance cell is second sibling after the Share ID cell in the same row
positional fallback: third row, third column is Balance

steps.description: Extract the Status for the row matching memberId-shareCode

locator.reason: Status cell is third sibling after the Share ID cell in the same row
positional fallback: third row, fourth column is Status
